ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the table lists “region, 1980, 1999”. In the planting area of commercial vegetables in 1980, suburbs of large cities accounted for 70%, and other agricultural areas accounted for 30%; by 1999, suburbs of large cities had decreased to 20%, and other agricultural areas had increased to 80%. Then reason: the main body of the planting area of commercial vegetables shifted from suburbs of large cities to the vast other agricultural areas, indicating that rural areas no longer mainly remained in subsistence agriculture, but carried out commercialized and specialized vegetable production oriented toward cities and markets, forming production bases and production-marketing systems. From the perspective of rural agricultural development modes, this conforms to the characteristics of the development of agricultural industrialization in rural areas.
